name: Pipe Networks
summary: Brisbane corporate data/telecom provider (PIPE = Public Internet Peering Exchange, ACN 099 104 122), founded 2001 by Bevan Slattery & Steve Baxter; metro fibre (from May 2002), data centres, dark fibre, corporate/wholesale internet backhaul (not a consumer ISP); listed ASX 2005 (PWK); acquired by TPG (SP Telemedia) 2010 (~$373M); fibre later to Vocus 2025.

events.details: Acquired by TPG/SP Telemedia (~$373M, approved 17 Mar 2010).
